candidates.change_summary: Delete the `depositsCount++` statement so deposits are no longer counted.
Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount += 2` so each deposit increments the counter by two.
Replace `depositsCount++` with `depositsCount--` so each deposit decrements the counter.
Insert an extra `depositsCount++;` so each deposit increments the counter by two.
Replace the withdrawn amount with 0 so withdrawAll transfers no ether instead of the full balance.
Delete the withdraw call so withdrawAll performs no transfer at all.
Invert the ownership check so any non-owner can call withdrawAll and drain the contract.
Remove the transfer statement so withdraw sends no ether.
Transfer the full contract balance instead of the requested _value, leaving different remaining balance.
Remove the require check so the modifier imposes no owner restriction.
Invert the require so only non-owners may call owner-guarded functions.
Remove the low-level call so no ether is sent to the target.
Replace the unrestricted call with a transfer, which forwards limited gas and reverts on failure instead of returning false.
Drop the onlyOwner guard from sendMoney so any address can send funds.
Invert the ownership check so the guard passes only for non-owners.
